slides.title: Winter coats are about to eat your hallway. Finds that stop it.
slides.sub: Before the first snow, not after

slides.title: A row of sturdy wall hooks
slides.body: One hook per person, at their height. Hanging a coat is one move, so it actually happens.

slides.title: An over-the-door rack
slides.body: No drilling needed. Turns the back of the closet door into coat space in minutes.

slides.title: A boot tray with a lip
slides.body: Wet boots go on the tray, not the floor. Melting snow stays put.

slides.title: One basket per person
slides.body: Hats, gloves, scarves. No folding, no pairing. Toss it in on the way past.

slides.title: A hanging shoe organizer
slides.body: Clear pockets for kids' mittens. If you can see it, you can find it at 7:45am.

slides.title: If putting it away takes two steps, it lives on the floor.
